responsibility: This AWK generator emits GCC’s option header, typically options.h, from merged .opt records. It generates the gcc_options, cl_optimization, and cl_target_option structures; externs and macros for option variables; language masks; mask bit definitions and TARGET_* accessors; option enums and metadata declarations; and the prototypes for generated option handlers. Its role is to create the type and macro interface that the rest of GCC uses to access parsed command-line options.
